about: Every simulation figure on the site. tools/label_figures.py writes a 'SIMULATION · synthetic data' strip above each one and the same words into its metadata; build.py fails if a listed figure lacks them or if an image in assets/img/swell/ isn't listed here. The unlabelled originals are the simulation outputs in the SWELL download (docs/design/figs/).
